items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: And you take Saeed, Saeed was a good man then too. He used to be a good drummer.

ctx.x: In the old days who were the best drummers did you think? Well that boy there, that Faso boy was one of the tops. And you take Saeed, Saeed was a good man then too. He used to be a good drummer. And this boy, Burgard, B-Gard, yeah. Well that was another good drummer.
Who were the best guitar players you liked to work with?

items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I was on a tour with, uh, Billy, the D, and, uh, Nelson, and, uh, Faisal. I'm not Faisal, uh, Saeed.

ctx.x: So, I... Did you go on any tours with, uh, with George, or, you went on tours, but did you go on any with him?

No, yeah, that's when George got sick. I went into Europe. See, I was on a tour with, uh, Billy, the D, and, uh, Nelson, and, uh, Faisal. I'm not Faisal, uh, Saeed. And George taking sick over there. We left George over there.
Was that in 60... do you remember the year of that?
